scripts.script:
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local SENHA_CORRETA = "mik12"

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "UniversalRawMenu"
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local MenuFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MenuFrame.Name = "MenuFrame"
MenuFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MenuFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 290)
MenuFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.2, 0)
MenuFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
MenuFrame.BorderSizePixel = 1

local LoginArea = Instance.new("Frame")
LoginArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
LoginArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoginArea.Parent = MenuFrame

local PasswordInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
PasswordInput.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 35)
PasswordInput.Position = UDim2.new(0.09, 0, 0.2, 0)
PasswordInput.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
PasswordInput.PlaceholderText = "Senha..."
PasswordInput.Text = ""
PasswordInput.TextSize = 14
PasswordInput.Parent = LoginArea

local LoginBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
LoginBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 35)
LoginBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.09, 0, 0.5, 0)
LoginBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
LoginBtn.Text = "LOGAR"
LoginBtn.TextSize = 14
LoginBtn.Parent = LoginArea

local HackArea = Instance.new("Frame")
HackArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
HackArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HackArea.Visible = false
HackArea.Parent = MenuFrame

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Parent = HackArea
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

local function criarInterruptor(texto, ordem)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    Btn.Text = texto .. ": OFF"
    Btn.TextSize = 12
    Btn.LayoutOrder = ordem
    Btn.Parent = HackArea
    return Btn
end

local BtnFullBright = criarInterruptor("FullBright", 1)
local BtnNoFog = criarInterruptor("Remover Neblina", 2)
local BtnEspBicho = criarInterruptor("ESP Criatura", 3)
local BtnEspPlayers = criarInterruptor("ESP Jogadores", 4)
local BtnAutoCollect = criarInterruptor("Auto Coleta Itens", 5)
local BtnAutoFuse = criarInterruptor("Auto Ligar Fusivel", 6)

local StateFullBright = false
local StateNoFog = false
local StateEspBicho = false
local StateEspPlayers = false
local StateAutoCollect = false
local StateAutoFuse = false

local originalAmbient = Lighting.Ambient
local originalBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
local originalFogColor = Lighting.FogColor
local originalFogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd

local function criarEspTexto(objeto, texto, cor, tagNome)
    if not objeto:FindFirstChild(tagNome) then
        local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        BillboardGui.Name = tagNome
        BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
        BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 25)
        BillboardGui.Adornee = objeto
        BillboardGui.Parent = objeto
        TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        TextLabel.TextColor3 = cor
        TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
        TextLabel.TextSize = 11
        TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        TextLabel.Text = texto
        TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
    end
end

LoginBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if PasswordInput.Text == SENHA_CORRETA then
        LoginArea.Visible = false
        HackArea.Visible = true
    else
        LoginBtn.Text = "ERRADA!"
        task.wait(1)
        LoginBtn.Text = "LOGAR"
    end
end)

BtnFullBright.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    StateFullBright = not StateFullBright
    if StateFullBright then
        BtnFullBright.Text = "FullBright: ON"
    else
        BtnFullBright.Text = "FullBright: OFF"
        Lighting.Ambient = originalAmbient
        Lighting.Brightness = originalBrightness
    end
end)

BtnNoFog.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    StateNoFog = not StateNoFog
    if StateNoFog then
        BtnNoFog.Text = "Remover Neblina: ON"
    else
        BtnNoFog.Text = "Remover Neblina: OFF"
        Lighting.FogColor = originalFogColor
        Lighting.FogEnd = originalFogEnd
    end
end)

BtnEspBicho.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    StateEspBicho = not StateEspBicho
    if not StateEspBicho then
        BtnEspBicho.Text = "ESP Criatura: OFF"
        for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name == "BichoESP" then obj:Destroy() end
        end
    else
        BtnEspBicho.Text = "ESP Criatura: ON"
    end
end)

BtnEspPlayers.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    StateEspPlayers = not StateEspPlayers
    if not StateEspPlayers then
        BtnEspPlayers.Text = "ESP Jogadores: OFF"
        for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name == "PlayerESP" then obj:Destroy() end
        end
    else
        BtnEspPlayers.Text = "ESP Jogadores: ON"
    end
end)

BtnAutoCollect.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    StateAutoCollect = not StateAutoCollect
    if not StateAutoCollect then
        BtnAutoCollect.Text = "Auto Coleta Itens: OFF"
        for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name == "ItemESP" then obj:Destroy() end
        end
    else
        BtnAutoCollect.Text = "Auto Coleta Itens: ON"
    end
end)

BtnAutoFuse.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    StateAutoFuse = not StateAutoFuse
    if StateAutoFuse then
        BtnAutoFuse.Text = "Auto Ligar Fusivel: ON"
    else
        BtnAutoFuse.Text = "Auto Ligar Fusivel: OFF"
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if StateFullBright then
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        Lighting.Brightness = 2.5
    end
    if StateNoFog then
        Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        Lighting.FogEnd = 999999
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if not (StateAutoFuse or StateEspPlayers or StateEspBicho or StateAutoCollect) then
            task.wait(1)
        else
            task.wait(0.6)
            
            for _, subObj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if StateAutoFuse and (subObj.Name:lower():find("fuse") or subObj.Name:lower():find("breaker") or subObj.Name:lower():find("caixa")) then
                    local click = subObj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector")
                    if click then fireclickdetector(click) end
                end

                local playerAssociado = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(subObj)
                if StateEspPlayers and playerAssociado and playerAssociado ~= LocalPlayer then
                    if not subObj:FindFirstChild("PlayerESP") then
                        local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
                        Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                        Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                        Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        Highlight.Parent = subObj
                    end
                end

                if StateEspBicho and subObj:IsA("Model") and subObj:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not playerAssociado then
                    if not subObj:FindFirstChild("BichoESP") then
                        local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        Highlight.Name = "BichoESP"
                        Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                        Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                        Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        Highlight.Parent = subObj
                    end
                end

                if StateAutoCollect and (subObj:IsA("Tool") or subObj:IsA("ClickDetector") or subObj:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or 
                    subObj.Name:lower():find("token") or subObj.Name:lower():find("coin") or 
                    subObj.Name:lower():find("item") or subObj.Name:lower():find("key") or 
                    subObj.Name:lower():find("bateria") or subObj.Name:lower():find("fuse")) 
                    and not subObj:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then
                    
                    local partAlvo = subObj:IsA("BasePart") and subObj or subObj.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if partAlvo then
                        criarEspTexto(partAlvo, subObj.Name:upper(), Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255), "ItemESP")
                        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and subObj:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local meuHRP = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                            if (meuHRP.Position - subObj.Position).Magnitude < 45 then
                                firetouchinterest(meuHRP, subObj, 0)
                                firetouchinterest(meuHRP, subObj, 1)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
